{{Quote|You have proved to be the top of your class, and so now is the time of The Gathering. For a Jedi, there is no greater challenge or honor.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to a class of Jedi Initiates|<ref name="TCW-TheGathering" />}}
'''The Gathering''' was a part of the training process of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] which also served as a rite of passage for [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] prior to their beginning training as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner. It was established at the beginning of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order and was preserved into the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The Gathering was an exercise which took place on the ancient Jedi [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. A group of Jedi Initiates would be transported to the frozen world to claim their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] for the first time. The process was a lesson to teach the young Jedi to overcome their own personal fears or failings. A [[Gathering (20 BBY)/Legends|Gathering]] was held around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] for a class of six younglings.

==Process==
The Gathering began with a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] being transported to one of the few worlds where lightsaber crystals could be found, often the ice [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of a higher rank. Once on Ilum, the Jedi traveled together to the entrance of the ancient [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] located at the mouth of the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]].<ref name="TCW-TheGathering" />

At the entrance to the Temple, the group of young Jedi would endure their first test of skill. Their guide would direct the group to focus their concentration on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], that only their combined efforts would be able to open the sealed entrance to the Temple. Once inside, the group was provided with guidance by an experienced [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="TCW-TheGathering" />

Following this, the group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] were required to descend into the catacombs of the Crystal Caves in order to search out the lightsaber crystal which would become theirs. Before going inside they would be told that they only have a limited period of time in which to search, as the entrance to the caves would freeze shut with the setting of the planet's sun. As revealed by Yoda however, the wall is only frozen water and therefore simple to break through, if one has the will. The deception is simply part of the test.<ref name="TCW-TheGathering" />

Once inside the labyrinth the journey became more personalized to each individual initiate. Though some would require others by nature of their learning process, the quest to find one's crystal generally featured a test of character tailored to each individual trainee's fear or failing before being able to successfully claim their prize and exit the cave.<ref name="TCW-TheGathering" />
